description: A2 daily_conversation: one observable learning goal through exact review assets; human rubric required.

input.idea: Teach the English phrase 'Could you say that again?' to worldwide non-native elementary learners (A2 planning level). After this lesson the learner can ask for repetition when they do not hear a meeting place clearly. Show a short natural dialogue with a helpful response and a clarification of the place. Do not assume a workplace, national culture or shared first language. Make exactly 5 slides. Use simple English-first teaching with visual explanation, no mandatory translation. End with one small practice action. CEFR labels are planning guides, not certification.
